purpose: Operator-selected optimization targets, not user-supplied SLA or measured results
baseline_reference: User reports approximately 15 minute per-instance startup and 9-10 minute warmup; measure actual source-install baseline independently
readiness: Real EC2 routing/TURN browser call has audio and sustained decoded fresh video with negotiated production codec; health or model-load success is insufficient
measurement_start: Before the EC2 create request, or before the restart request for restart runs
cache_classification: Unknown unless provider/local evidence establishes cold or cached; do not claim a cold pass from a cached pull
sampling: Report every observation and min/median/max; three runs do not establish a statistically reliable p95
budget_precedence: Do not exceed approved total or traffic rates to obtain repeat counts; missing repetitions remain incomplete
